campaignScope: Media PDP-0 acceptance outcome quality; Recorder/Studio and declarative production cases
reviewMode: Independent read-only second pass; complements actor-inheritance review in acceptance-cases-84-61-review.json

criteria.givenPreconditions: Every case has a nonempty given. Recorder cases state the intent/source/project/admission condition; declarative cases state the shared source+authorized revision condition or the TutorPutor public-contract condition. The separate actor inheritance finding from the first pass remains outstanding for 49 declarative cases; this second pass found no additional condition gap beyond it.
criteria.whenAndPositiveOutcome: All 145 have nonempty, case-specific when and then; evaluated the positive outcome for alignment with the declared source capability and parent requirement.
criteria.rejectionAndUnavailable: All 145 have a rejection condition. Cases that depend on a provider, permission, source, solver, finality or rights also define denied/unavailable/unknown behavior in the case or a shared source-bound downstream profile. Cases not claiming those contingent effects do not need a fabricated unavailable state.
criteria.authoritativeReadback: Explicit product-effect/readback claims are bounded: Recorder AC-013 records typed owner result/postcondition/finality; AC-043 reconciles exact request identity and authoritative outcome; AC-045 compares the owner result/postcondition to the authored journey. Declarative result contracts require exact model/media result, source version, effect finality, denial and safe recovery. Scientific outputs remain model-owner-scoped and are not treated as business-effect receipts.
criteria.surfaceAndRequirementTrace: Every case has an owning logical surface, canonical parent requirement, capability leaf and direct ownership of that capability by the cited parent requirement; all cited leaf IDs exist in the canonical capabilities source.
criteria.downstreamObligations: Recorder 84-case downstream counts are explicitly 84 in the PDP-1 operation crosswalk and PDP-2 acceptance-case projection. Declarative 61 IDs have exact PDP-1 operation bindings, exact PDP-2 interface bindings, and 61 PDP-3 case-experience source IDs in raw source. These are trace-obligation observations, not proof that the later PDP definitions are complete or accepted.
